groups.title: Pacing experiments
groups.note: Eleven renderings of one section — First Talk · Knowing Each One Three Ways — testing what actually slows eleven_multilingual_v2 down. Whitespace, <break> tags and punctuation all did nothing; only time-stretch and real spliced silence worked. Sample 11 is the technique that ships.

groups.title: Mandarin voice auditions & pre-slowdown originals
groups.note: The only true multi-take material in the project. Every live Mandarin track is one of these at 30% slower (ffmpeg atempo=0.7692), and alongside the normal-speed originals sit real alternates: the title and preface in Hardy, a Taiwanese voice that was live before CarterSutra replaced it, and the opening at 10%, 20% and 30% slower so the pacing choice can be heard side by side. First Talk carries the audition notes.
